rules.requirement: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.

assertingTests.name: a Recluse registers as evil, a Minion or a Demon and a Spy as good, a Townsfolk or an Outsider even when dead (TB-RECLUSE-02, TB-SPY-01)
a drunk or poisoned Spy or Recluse registration never applies to an ability (TB-RECLUSE-01, TB-SPY-01)
the Spy step is built on every night with the grimoire shape and no target (TB-SPY-01, SYS-NIGHT-02)
the Spy sees the Grimoire every night and stores no answer (TB-SPY-01)
the Spy step stores the grimoire whatever answer is sent with it (TB-SPY-01)
a poisoned Spy is shown the grimoire without a question and the step is marked impaired (TB-SPY-01, SYS-EFFECTS-01)
a Spy killed by the Demon loses its step of that night (TB-SPY-01)
the Spy step previews, applies and replays with the command clock and ids, also with an answer sent (TB-SPY-01)
the Spy module declares a step for every night with the grimoire shape (TB-SPY-01)
the Spy reads no fact, so its decision is the same whether or not its owner is drunk or poisoned (TB-SPY-01, SYS-EFFECTS-01)
